method: Artifact Tool authors, recalculates and renders the donor. This stdlib-only adapter transfers its reviewed cells while preserving every unrelated ZIP payload byte.

renderProjection.purpose: Temporary read-only Artifact Tool rendering projection; never a delivered workbook.
renderProjection.scope: Render the two complete guide sheets and A1:F8 of the first historical sheet. Preservation of all other historical sheets is established by exact ZIP-payload comparison, not by this projection.
